ideas.title: The Rise of Tax Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the growing trend of tax fraud in Minnesota, including the recent case of a man accused of underreporting his income by nearly $2M
questions: What are the root causes of tax fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent similar cases in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue in Minnesota, and to provide insights into the causes and consequences of tax fraud. I will be tracking this story and others like it, to identify patterns and connections between entities and programs.
